usageNotes: Returns the ordered list of firewall rules applied to a specific LXC container on a PDM-managed PVE remote; rules are returned in positional order (pos field) which determines evaluation sequence. Requires Resource.Audit privilege on the remote+vmid path — read-only tokens are sufficient. If the container is managed by a cluster, supply the optional node parameter to target the specific cluster member hosting the container; omitting it lets PDM resolve the node automatically.

examples.summary: List all firewall rules for LXC 102 on the 'hetzner-pve' remote

tips: Rules with enable=0 are present in the list but inactive; check this field before assuming a rule is enforced.
The action field may contain a security group name instead of ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT when a group reference is used — handle both cases when parsing results.
pos values are zero-indexed and determine match order; a lower pos value is evaluated first.
An empty array response means no container-level rules exist; cluster or datacenter-level rules may still apply to traffic.
